name: Claude Real Video
role: Local video analysis CLI producing scene-aware keyframes and transcripts
notes: 2026-11-24: Guide written at skills/claude-real-video/SKILL.md from the claude-real-video-keyframes evidence; default density-floor output, fades, real footage, transcripts and URL ingestion remain untested.
2026-11-15: Triage: assess; selected keyframes and contact sheets could support agent-facing render review. Revisit when #63 frame sampling is exercised and frame selection repeatability is checked.

2026-11-15: Skill opportunity: a focused review-packet workflow may merit a VCR skill if the tool reliably produces the needed keyframes and transcript; fixture retrieval and transcription separately.

evidence.result: 3 keyframes at frames 0, 48, 96 (0 frames off, tolerance ±1), each 320x240; 3 frames extracted, none deduped; reruns identical; passes under a deny-network sandbox
evidence.scope: Local scene gate finds two authored cuts (frames 48, 96) in a generated 3-shot clip, one keyframe per shot; no real-footage, transcript or URL claim.

summary: Python CLI and API analyse a local video or URL and emit deduplicated scene-aware keyframes plus a transcript. Its analysis window and contact-sheet workflow can prepare compact visual evidence for human or agent review; URL downloads and transcription add external dependency and model variability.
use_when: Create scene-aware keyframes and a transcript for a review packet
Analyse only a selected time window instead of sampling the full video
Use its combined visual and speech output rather than extracting frames alone
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg when you need exact deterministic frame extraction or media transformation
Use a dedicated transcription tool when transcript accuracy and word timing are the main job

assessment.rationale: Official release 0.10.7 (2026-09-26) documents scene-aware, deduplicated keyframes and transcript output for local files or URLs. MIT; download and transcription dependencies can vary, so review reproducibility before relying on it as a measurement tool.
